text:
tara_ops: Heads up — seeing a cluster of failed GPU node provisions in us-west-2 after last-night's OOB fleet push. BMCs on a subset of blades flipped boot flags and secure boot toggled to UEFI-only. Failed allocations ~12% for new jobs. Anyone oncall?
kevin_infra: Confirming. We saw provisioning service retrying and spilling to eu-west which caused ~35% cost bump for the hour. IPMI sessions drop right after the flash, then node never comes up for PXE.
liam_sre: On it. Can you paste a few failed node IDs?
tara_ops: Node IDs:
- rack-14u-02
- rack-14u-05
- rack-21u-11
Sample check I ran:
```
# check secure boot attribute via IPMI (placeholder creds)
ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.0.14.2 -U admin -P password raw 0x0 0xA
# returns: BootFlag: UEFI-SecureBoot=ENABLED\n```
kevin_infra: stack traces show failures in bmc-conn layer at the same time as the flash commit. Looks like the new image toggles a UEFI attr during init even when not requested.
sophia_oncall: I've temporarily paused the auto cross-region fallback to stop further cost bleed. Paused for 30m and notified billing. Rolling back the OOB image on a 10-node canary set now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback job queued: rollback-image v1.3.4 -> v1.3.2 on canary-set-2026. 10 nodes affected. ETA 12m.
liam_sre: Thanks. Two immediate asks: 1) add a pre-provision BMC check to gate on BootFlag state, 2) signal provisioning-service to respect a new "bmc-flash-in-flight" tag so we don't reroute. Sample pre-check to add to hook:
```
# pseudo pre-provision hook
bmc_state=$(ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U $USER -P $PASS raw 0x0 0xA)
if echo "$bmc_state" | grep -q "UEFI-SecureBoot=ENABLED"; then
  echo "fail: unexpected secureboot state"; exit 1
fi
```
kevin_infra: I'll open a PR to add the hook and emit metric `bmc_secureboot_toggle_total`. Also adding a short-circuit to provisioning to not trigger cross-region fallback if toggle_count > 0 within 5m.
tara_ops: Good. Also we should add a small runbook step for oncall: "if BMC toggles during flash, pause fleet rollout and kick rollback". I'll draft and ping SRE.
sophia_oncall: Creating incident INC-2026-042 in ops and assigning owners @kevin_infra @liam_sre. Notifying product about potential perf/cost impact.
kevin_infra: FYI: early mitigation for customers — we can pin existing hosts to older BMC image via config flag to avoid churn while we validate fix.
liam_sre: Agreed. After rollback completes, let's run a quick 100-node canary with ipmi probe every 10s for 5m to ensure no silent flips.
sophia_oncall: Rollback successful on canary (6/6 nodes healthy). Staging rollout paused until canary run passes.
tara_ops: Thx team. Action items: KEVIN -> PR for probe + metric; LIAM -> canary probe job; SOPHIA -> incident + billing note; TARA -> runbook update.
kevin_infra: I'll also add alert rule: `sum(rate(bmc_secureboot_toggle_total[5m])) > 0` -> severity=P2.
liam_sre: Also recommend we add a post-deploy verification step to image pipeline to assert bootflag idempotence.
kevin_infra: Agree.
sophia_oncall: Closing temporary pause at +30m. Monitoring for any regressions. :thumbsup: :money_with_wings:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: note: cost-anomaly alert triggered for us-west-2 due to cross-region spillover. Billing alerted.
tara_ops: Filing follow-up doc in infra-runbooks: /runbooks/bmc-bootflag-fallback.md. Will update when PR merged. :white_check_mark:
